name: nangate15
notes: Nangate 15 nm Open Cell Library, typical corner: 0.80 V, 25 C. out_load_ff is four INV_X4 inputs (4 x 3.301 fF). The library has no wire-load models. Its flops (DFFRNQ_X1, DFFSNQ_X1) all have an async reset or set, so Vitis's synchronous reset costs a flop with an unused reset pin plus reset logic.
